provenance.notes: The Free plan lists "Unlimited challenges (traffic or verification requests)": no rate limit declared. Free: up to 20 widgets, 10 hostnames per widget, analytics over 7 days; Cloudflare's branding stays on the widget (removing it is Enterprise's "Offlabel"), nothing else to credit. No commercial restriction: the Free plan is described for personal sites, small to medium businesses and most production applications. Caching, storage and redistribution are not addressed (a token is single use: there is nothing to cache).
